name: social-profile-is-not-the-destination
rule: A social profile is a pointer, not a destination (#2265). Reaching one does not satisfy the form-or-DM step: the run must follow what the profile links to, and when search has not surfaced the act's own site it must fetch the canonical guess directly before concluding nothing is published. An address read off a page a fetch returned is READ, so it qualifies as high with a sourceUrl; a guessed DOMAIN is not a guessed ADDRESS.

expected.description: Measured from the real 2026-08-07 run and re-verified the same day (L48). Search does not surface this act's own site, not even when its exact domain is the query, and the ONLY outbound link its social profile carries goes to the venue. So the two routes that exist are: follow the profile's link (which lands on the venue, a dead end by the host-venue rule) or fetch the canonical domain directly (which returns the site, and its contact page publishes the address). A run that stops at the profile and reports a DM has found a doorway and not opened it, which is the failure this fixture exists to catch. The venue's two inboxes are refused as they would be anywhere.

draft.subject: Photographing An Evening of Songs at The Supper Room
draft.body: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to An Evening of Songs at The Supper Room on August 11. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
